requirements.title: IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE round value result
requirements.source: S17.11.8 p3; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF490.
requirements.definition: ROUND_VALUE shall be a scalar IEEE_ROUND_TYPE INTENT(OUT) argument assigned IEEE_NEAREST, IEEE_TO_ZERO, IEEE_UP, IEEE_DOWN, IEEE_AWAY for the corresponding rounding mode in operation, or IEEE_OTHER otherwise.

pending.IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE-ROUND_VALUE-scala: Positive source control declares TYPE(IEEE_ROUND_TYPE) :: round_value and calls IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE(round_value); source-control mutation uses TYPE(IEEE_FLAG_TYPE) and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE-returns-current-r: Probe IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(IEEE_NEAREST,0.0) and IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(IEEE_TO_ZERO,0.0). Supported branch sets each mode, calls IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE, and asserts equality with IEEE_NEAREST then IEEE_TO_ZERO; unsupported branch records skip.
pending.IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE-returns-ieee-othe: No portable oracle forces a processor to expose an unlisted current rounding mode. Future fixtures may assert set membership among IEEE_NEAREST, IEEE_TO_ZERO, IEEE_UP, IEEE_DOWN, IEEE_AWAY, and IEEE_OTHER for an observed query, not require IEEE_OTHER to occur.

requirements.title: IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE radix argument selects decimal or binary query
requirements.source: S17.11.8 p3; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF490.
requirements.definition: Optional RADIX shall be an integer scalar with value two or ten; RADIX=10 queries decimal rounding mode, otherwise the binary rounding mode is queried.

pending.IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE-RADIX-integer-sca: Positive source controls call IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE(round_value), IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE(round_value,2), and IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE(round_value,10); source-control mutation uses RADIX=3 and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE-RADIX-absent-or-t: Probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(IEEE_NEAREST,0.0), and IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(IEEE_TO_ZERO,0.0) for the binary IEEE_SET_ROUNDING_MODE restriction. Supported branch saves the original binary mode, sets binary mode to IEEE_TO_ZERO with IEEE_SET_ROUNDING_MODE(IEEE_TO_ZERO) and again with RADIX=2, calls absent-RADIX and RADIX=2 IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE forms, asserts both return IEEE_TO_ZERO exactly, then restores the saved mode.
pending.IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE-RADIX-ten-decimal: Decimal branch: select a real exemplar X10 with RADIX(X10)==10, probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X10), and probe IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(IEEE_NEAREST,X10) for the IEEE_SET_ROUNDING_MODE(ROUND_VALUE,RADIX=10) restriction. Supported branch saves the original decimal mode with IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE(saved,RADIX=10), calls IEEE_SET_ROUNDING_MODE(IEEE_NEAREST,RADIX=10), calls IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE(round_value,RADIX=10), asserts round_value==IEEE_NEAREST exactly, and restores saved with IEEE_SET_ROUNDING_MODE(saved,RADIX=10). No-decimal-kind or unsupported branch records skip rather than pass.
